test.create_query: CREATE TABLE uniq_tiny_states ( k UInt64, s AggregateFunction(uniq, UInt64) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE uniq_big_states ( g UInt64, s AggregateFunction(uniq, UInt64) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY g
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO uniq_tiny_states SELECT number, arrayReduce('uniqState', arrayMap(i -> number * 16 + i, range(2 + (number % 2) * 7))) FROM numbers_mt(5000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
INSERT INTO uniq_big_states SELECT intDiv(number, 60000) AS g, uniqState(number) FROM numbers_mt(30000000) GROUP BY g SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT sum(finalizeAggregation(s)) FROM uniq_tiny_states FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT uniqMerge(s) FROM uniq_tiny_states FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT k % 1000, uniqMerge(s) FROM uniq_tiny_states GROUP BY k % 1000 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT uniqMerge(s) FROM uniq_big_states FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT g % 4, uniqMerge(s) FROM uniq_big_states GROUP BY g % 4 FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
